verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's remote MCP server lets agents run read-write SQL through the query_rw tool, including INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, table creation and schema changes. Because these are set-based statements, one operation can change many rows or tables at once. The docs also cover bulk-scale workloads such as backfills on Mega instances, loading whole databases or tables from other sources, and scheduled Flights Python jobs for ingest and transformation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation framing these as bulk or batch operations (limits, transactional guarantees for large multi-item changes), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven bulk writes.
